three_layers.physical: Stream consistently beside clearing; mossed stone fragments, old boulders, compressed leaf litter and two visible approach areas. Relative scale accommodates four-hoof anatomy. Sunrise from same side across triad.
three_layers.civil: Peopled-kind upland martial domain; candidate ordinary use by training attendants and maintenance workers, not a new sovereign order. Separate communal court access from private forest solitude.
three_layers.memory: Use worn standing areas and unevenly weathered stone as evidence of repeated use, not dated battles. Wilson's prior public defeats and ObiWan's prior title pressure inform present choices; no inherited personal victory counts or transfer of Belt.

four_era_development: 2015–18: long-used woodland approach, weathered ruin fragments and stream-side ground; no claim of who built ruins or used them then.
2019–21: propose incremental maintenance of paths and old stone edges as training and communal travel continue; no claim of a championship-driven construction.
2022–23: propose layered signs of ordinary use and upkeep, a contrast to changing league fortunes.
2024–26: retain aged ground and recent maintenance; DK trains after bridge defeat, not because the clearing was newly built.
material_art_direction: Layer weathered stone and undated plain repair; moss, leaf litter, worn earth, mature trees. No magical growth, battle relics or transplanted bridge.
lighting: Low warm sunrise on one consistent side; still air.

relative_layout.axis: Stream left, ruins behind clearing, two distinct woodland approaches; relative layout only, no invented map bearing.

shot_reference.establishing: Wide, stream and ruins readable; open ground visibly suitable for both principals.
shot_reference.detail: Ground-level stones and compressed leaf litter; preserve physical scale.
